about_the_game:
Stranded at Sea is a fast‑paced, first‑person parkour challenge set in the middle of the ocean. Your only path to safety is across a chain of floating rafts, barrels, and makeshift platforms — each one shifting and bobbing with the waves. Race against the clock, leap over gaps, and use your skill to survive the unpredictable water physics as you push toward the flare at the end of each level to signal your rescue.

Every jump counts. Each level is built for speedrunning, with tight platforming sequences hand designed by our developers to require precision, determination, and composure. The faster you finish, the higher you climb on the public leaderboards — compete against the world or focus on beating your own best times.

With simple, clean 3D visuals, a custom water and buoyancy system, and a difficulty curve that ramps up to intense, near-impossible challenges, Stranded at Sea rewards precision, timing, and persistence. Whether you’re here for the thrill of competition or the satisfaction of mastering each obstacle, the ocean is waiting — and it won’t make it easy.
